t: The AI Orchestra: A Blueprint for Reproducible, Human-AI Development
s: Pipulate system combines rapid prototyping, reproducible environments, and scalable deployment using Nix for universal portability, Git for auto-updates, and a 'Sacrificial Workspace' to streamline human-AI collaborative software development.
sub: Universal portability via Nix flakes for identical Linux environments.
'Sacrificial Workspace' design for user edits outside Git for seamless auto-updates.
AI Orchestra model for human-AI collaboration in development lifecycle.
Bridging Jupyter Notebook prototyping to web applications via shared core logic.
Installation script using curl/sh to bootstrap Nix and initialize Git repos.
